failure_definition: ICD lead fracture causing failure to deliver therapy
causal_mechanism: cyclic mechanical stress (cardiac motion) and abrasion against vascular structures or other leads
current_device_behavior: delivers therapy to the heart using a multifilar coaxial lead design
failure_point: high-stress points, such as near the tricuspid valve or subclavian crush zone
blocking_constraint: the need to maintain electrical conductivity and insulation integrity while minimizing the risk of lead fracture and failure
